tickets.title: Build retirement income plan
tickets.text: Create a retirement income plan that converts Evelyn Lanternmoss's goals, available resources, expected income sources, tax considerations, and portfolio constraints into a sustainable withdrawal and cash-flow strategy. Document assumptions, identify planning gaps, and prepare recommendations for advisor review. Revise the monthly income plan to reflect Adrian Lanternmoss's lost $2,840 monthly Clockwork Clover Railworks pension, Evelyn's $38,000 part-time wages at Moonbadger Museum, the $2,150 monthly mortgage payment, available cash reserves, Social Security timing options, and potential withdrawals from the Velvet Acorn Custody taxable and retirement accounts.

subTasks.title: Gather retirement income inputs
subTasks.text: Collect current spending targets, anticipated retirement timing, pension or Social Security estimates, account types, cash reserves, recurring liabilities, and known major upcoming expenses.

subTasks.title: Model withdrawal and tax sequencing
subTasks.text: Compare withdrawal order options across taxable, tax-deferred, and tax-free accounts. Note estimated tax brackets, required minimum distribution considerations, and cash-flow timing tradeoffs.

subTasks.title: Stress-test plan assumptions
subTasks.text: Evaluate the plan under lower return, higher inflation, longer longevity, and unexpected expense scenarios. Flag assumptions that materially change the recommendation.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor summary
subTasks.text: Summarize recommended income sources, annual review triggers, tax-aware implementation steps, and open questions for client discussion.

tickets.evidence: Evelyn asked for a revised monthly income plan reflecting Adrian’s lost pension payment, her part-time wages, available cash reserves, the mortgage payment, Social Security timing options, and potential withdrawals from taxable and retirement accounts; the agreed follow-up is due 2026-01-23.
